subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, and if so which Track A-D sequencing is approved?
rationale: Source evidence confirms the problem class, but the proposed design chooses cross-surface lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence behavior, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable runtime surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the design direction and require each track to land as a focused PR with source, live, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Approve Track A only
options.body: Use this issue to guide abort-to-release and stale takeover now, while leaving liveness, durability, and completion-drive policy to separate later decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue resolving the linked production reports through narrower bug-specific fixes.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the design direction and require each track to land as a focused PR with source, live, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned the umbrella and opened the first Track A implementation candidate.
